title: Russian nuclear-powered submarine fires cruise missiles in Pacific drills
note: Russia's Pacific Fleet test-fired cruise missiles from a nuclear-powered submarine and hit a target 1,200 km away. It is a show of long-range strike capacity at a time of high tension with the US and its allies.

title: Security Council renews Haiti sanctions and arms embargo for a year
note: The Council adopted Resolution 2831 with 14 votes in favour and Russia abstaining, renewing the travel ban, asset freeze and arms embargo. The measures aim to cut off arms to gangs that control large parts of Port-au-Prince and are spreading into rural areas.
limitations: Renewal shows political will at the Council but does not show that the arms embargo is being enforced on the ground. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: China and North Korea open New Yalu River Bridge after 12-year delay
note: The two countries opened the bridge linking Dandong and Sinuiju. China is North Korea's largest trading partner and a lifeline against the sanctions Pyongyang faces, so the link eases a trade route under international pressure.
limitations: The reports do not say what goods will cross or whether the bridge will change compliance with UN sanctions. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.
